core_problem_solved: To provide a Java library for parsing and manipulating every element of an HTML document, with a strong focus on handling malformed documents and providing direct access to the stream of tags, attributes, and content.
key_features: High-performance parsing of valid or invalid HTML
Extraction of text and tag-specific content, including server-side tags
Ability to render modified HTML by replacing, inserting, or deleting elements
era_and_niche: A popular HTML parsing library for Java in the mid-to-late 2000s, often used for web scraping and detailed content analysis due to its robustness with real-world, messy HTML.
reason_for_obsolescence: The library is **inactive and considered obsolete**. The modern, de facto standard for HTML parsing, traversal, and manipulation in Java is **`org.jsoup:jsoup`**. Jsoup provides a more comprehensive and convenient API, including powerful CSS selectors, and is actively maintained.
